results.title: PlayAd Review & Alternative (2026) — ViralMojo
results.content:
PlayAd is a San Francisco startup building a managed "AI marketing team": named agent "employees" that take your brief, produce the creative, A/B test it, and buy the media across channels — with marketer-owned interactive/playable ads as its flagship wedge. It has announced a $5.4M raise to expand that agent team. Pricing runs Intern $39/mo (330 credits, 1 ad account) → Part Time $99 → Full Time $499 → CMO $1,799 → Enterprise custom, with yearly billing 20% cheaper; the homepage says it is free to start with no credit card (checked September 2026 — note its own page title still says "starting at $59/mo"). As of September 2026 there's no dedicated third-party review base yet — the Trustpilot page you'll find under "PlayAd" belongs to play.ai, a different company. It fits teams that want [...] Comparison pages have a trust problem — most shade the truth. Every competitor fact on this page is checked against public sources on the date shown, the ✕ marks on our own side are real, and the ads in the receipts table are public links you can verify. If anything here is out of date or unfair to the competitor, tell me and I'll fix it.

— Denzel,@denzelgeng7 on X

FAQ

## Should you switch from PlayAd? [...] Yes. Both help performance teams ship more winning creative, faster. The difference is who holds the wheel: PlayAd is a fully-managed "AI marketing team" — a crew of specialized agents that takes your brief and runs the loop for you, producing, A/B testing, and even buying the media. ViralMojo is an in-house agent you drive: it finds what's winning in your niche — organic and paid — decodes why, and writes the hooks and scripts in your customers' own words, working from just your product URL. The research and every creative decision stay with you. Distributed honesty: if what you want is to hand the whole job to a team that also runs your spend — especially for interactive/playable ads — PlayAd is purpose-built for exactly that.
